infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Raahi uses the camera to recognize where you are and to look for places you ask it to find.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Raahi listens for spoken commands like "find canteen" or "repeat".
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Raahi converts your spoken commands into text to control the app hands-free.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Raahi uses your location to guide you outdoors and to share your position if you trigger SOS.
